First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{4}\cdot {4}^{3x-5} & \ge {4}^{3x-1} \\ {x}^{4}\cdot {4}^{3x-5}-{4}^{3x-1} & \ge 0 \\ {x}^{4}\cdot {4}^{3x-5}-{4}^{4}\cdot {4}^{3x-5} & \ge 0 \\ ({x}^{4}-{4}^{4}){4}^{3x-5} & \ge 0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${4}^{3x-5}$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{({x}^{4}-{4}^{4}){4}^{3x-5}}{{4}^{3x-5}} & \ge \frac{0}{{4}^{3x-5}} \\ {x}^{4}-{4}^{4} & \ge 0.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we can solve this inequality using familiar methods:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{4}-{4}^{4} & \ge 0 \\ {x}^{4} & \ge {4}^{4} \\ \sqrt[4]{{x}^{4}} & \ge \sqrt[4]{{4}^{4}} \\ |x| & \ge 4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the inequality above is  $x\le -4$ or $x\ge 4.$
